instruction: Play the most listened to song on Spotify from my Woodstock Reimagined: Festival Vibes playlist.
notes: Single-app Spotify task. supervisor.show_profile yields the login username (email) and supervisor.show_account_passwords the spotify password; spotify.login yields the token. show_playlist_library (paginated in practice, no query) discovers the playlist id and its song_ids; show_song (no token needed) reveals play_count for each song and the agent selects the max. The playlist's songs are abstracted by a single representative object most-played-song, with the static fact (most-played ...) designating it as the song with the highest play_count; in execution show_song is invoked for every song_id in the playlist before choosing. play_music with song_id makes the MusicPlayer play that song (goal predicate playing). supervisor.complete_task is called with status=success and no answer; its song/playlist parameters are task records, not API arguments.
